description: Use this when the user wants commission statements for several reps, asks "how much commission did each rep earn this month", or attaches a deals export (CSV or Excel from a CRM or spreadsheet with rep, deal, amount, margin, close date, status columns; columns are matched automatically). Applies one plan to all reps (with per-rep quota, draw and prior balance overrides), handles split deals, SPIFFs, clawbacks, caps and draws, and returns a team summary, a commission statement PDF with one section per rep, and an Excel workbook listing each deal line. Does not compute taxes, withholding or take-home pay, and does not read PDF or image files. Do not use for a single quick commission question (use calculate_commission).

column_map.description: Only if automatic matching picks the wrong column: file header per field, e.g. {"amount":"Net Revenue","rep":"Opportunity Owner"}.

amount.description: Header of the amount column, e.g. "Amount".

cancel_date.description: Header of the cancel date column, e.g. "Cancel Date".

close_date.description: Header of the close date column, e.g. "Close Date".

commission_paid.description: Header of the commission paid column, e.g. "Commission Paid".

deal.description: Header of the deal column, e.g. "Opportunity Name".

margin.description: Header of the margin column, e.g. "Gross Profit".

margin_percent.description: Header of the margin percent column, e.g. "GM %".

rep.description: Header of the rep column, e.g. "Deal Owner".

spiff.description: Header of the spiff column, e.g. "SPIFF".

split_percent.description: Header of the split percent column, e.g. "Split %".

status.description: Header of the status column, e.g. "Stage".

company_name.description: Company name printed on the statements, e.g. "Acme Corp".

currency.description: ISO currency code, default USD, e.g. CAD or EUR.

deals.description: Typed deals when there is no file, each with rep (or splits), e.g. [{"rep":"Ana","deal":"Acme","amount":30000},{"deal":"Globex","amount":20000,"splits":[{"rep":"Ana","percent":60},{"rep":"Ben","percent":40}]}].

amount.description: Deal amount (revenue) in currency, e.g. 24000. Negative = credit or adjustment.

cancel_date.description: Refund or cancellation date for the clawback window, e.g. 2026-10-20.

close_date.description: Close date, e.g. 2026-09-14 or 9/14/2026 (US order). Sets the order in which deals fill tiers.

commission_paid.description: For a refunded deal from an earlier period: commission already paid on it, e.g. 1200. The clawback uses this amount.

deal.description: Deal, customer or invoice name, e.g. "Acme renewal".

margin.description: Gross margin amount of the deal, e.g. 7200 (for gross_margin plans).

margin_percent.description: Gross margin in percent of the amount, e.g. 30 (alternative to margin).

rep.description: Sales rep credited with the deal, e.g. "Maria Lopez".

spiff.description: SPIFF paid on this deal, e.g. 250 (outside tiers and cap; split with the deal).

split_percent.description: This rep's share of the deal in percent, e.g. 60 for a 60/40 split. Default 100.

splits.description: Split between reps instead of rep, e.g. [{"rep":"Ana","percent":60},{"rep":"Ben","percent":40}].

status.description: Deal status, e.g. won (default), refunded, cancelled, churned, chargeback, lost, open. Cancelled deals are clawed back; lost and open deals are not counted.

file.description: The deals export to read, CSV or Excel (.xlsx), e.g. september-deals.csv, with one deal per row.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

period_end.description: Last day of the period, e.g. 2026-09-30.

period_label.description: Label printed on statements, e.g. "September 2026" or "Q3 2026".

period_start.description: First day of the commission period, e.g. 2026-09-01. Deals closed outside the period are not counted.

plan.description: One plan applied to all reps (per-rep quota, draw and balance go in rep_overrides), e.g. {"rate":8,"clawback_window_days":90}.

base_salary.description: Base salary for the same period as ote, e.g. 15000.

bonuses.description: One-off bonuses or SPIFFs for the period, outside tiers and the cap, e.g. [{"label":"President's club SPIFF","amount":1000}].

label.description: Bonus or SPIFF name, e.g. "Q3 new-logo SPIFF".

cap_amount.description: Maximum commission on deals for the period, e.g. 25000. SPIFFs and bonuses are outside the cap.

clawback_percent.description: Share of the original commission clawed back, in percent, default 100.

clawback_window_days.description: Days after close in which a refund or cancellation claws back commission, e.g. 90. Leave out to claw back any cancellation.

commission_base.description: What the rate applies to: revenue (deal amount, default) or gross_margin (each deal's margin or margin_percent).

draw_amount.description: Draw against commission paid for the period, e.g. 3000.

draw_type.description: recoverable (default: a shortfall carries forward and is repaid from later commission) or non_recoverable (the shortfall is forgiven, not repaid).

name.description: Plan label, e.g. "AE plan FY26" or "Plan A".

ote.description: On-target earnings for the period, e.g. 30000; use with base_salary to derive target variable pay = OTE - base salary.

quota.description: Quota for the period in currency, e.g. 150000. Used for attainment and quota-percent tiers.

rate.description: Flat commission rate in percent, e.g. 10 for 10%. With tiers that use multipliers this is the base commission rate.

target_variable.description: Target variable (incentive) pay at 100% of quota for the period, e.g. 15000. With quota it sets the base commission rate = target_variable / quota.

tier_method.description: marginal (stepped: each slice of sales at its own tier rate) or retroactive (all sales at the rate of the highest tier reached). Leave out when the plan wording does not say; both results are then shown.

tier_unit.description: Tier limits in currency (amount, default) or in percent of quota attainment (quota_percent, needs quota).

tiers.description: Tiered rates in ascending order. "5% up to 50k then 8% above" = [{"up_to":50000,"rate":5},{"up_to":null,"rate":8}]. Accelerator over quota with tier_unit quota_percent: [{"up_to":100,"rate":10},{"up_to":null,"rate":15}].

multiplier.description: Instead of a rate: a multiple of the base commission rate, e.g. 1.5 for an accelerator above quota or 0.5 for a decelerator below 50% of quota.

rate.description: Commission rate for this tier in percent, e.g. 8 for 8%.

up_to.description: Upper limit of this tier, inclusive, in currency (e.g. 50000) or in percent of quota when tier_unit is quota_percent (e.g. 100). Leave null on the last, open-ended tier.

unknown_status_as_won.description: Count deals whose status is not recognised (e.g. "Signed - pending") as closed-won. Default false: they are listed as not counted.

rep_name.description: Rep to credit when the file has no rep column, e.g. "Maria Lopez".

rep_overrides.description: Per-rep quota, target variable, draw or prior balance, e.g. [{"rep":"Ana","quota":120000,"draw_amount":2000}].

draw_amount.description: This rep's draw for the period, e.g. 2500.

prior_balance.description: Unrecovered draw or clawback balance this rep still owes from earlier periods, e.g. 800.

quota.description: This rep's quota for the period, e.g. 120000.

rep.description: Rep name as it appears in the deals, e.g. "Maria Lopez".

target_variable.description: This rep's target variable pay, e.g. 12000.

sheet_name.description: Excel sheet to read, e.g. "Closed Won". Default: the first sheet with an amount column.

name: generate_commission_statements
title: Generate commission statements
